issues.desc: background.md Key Insight references "the spec" ("The spec is explicit: never invent a budget") and index.json description references "spec Touchpoint 4" without identifying which document the spec is. A new reader cannot locate or verify this design anchor. The spec document path or title should be named.

background.md Conversation Texture (line 11) lists B-253e/B-08a1/B-a5c9/B-97df as predecessor stories with no per-story explanation beyond "This follows...". B-0f7c is explained on first appearance (line 2) but the other four receive no context. A new reader cannot determine what each predecessor contributed.
